# Christian Vari

> Security Researcher — Founder & CEO of Codezen, Head of Audit Operations at Oak Security. Securing blockchain protocols, consensus engines, cross-chain bridges, smart contracts, financial systems. 189 completed audits and 2361 issues found across Solana, Cosmos SDK, Polkadot SDK, Ethereum and EVM.

Markdown versions of every page are available; prefer them over the HTML.
